config.claim_boundary: Diagnoses and replaces the invalid five-row pose average used by the exhausted selective-virtual-sensing cohort. It does not reopen or revise that prospective result and is not a prospective accuracy claim.

source_cohort.outcome_status: 23 opened evaluations plus one target-free quality failure

deform360.action_schema: row 0 is end-effector translation, rows 1:4 are rotation, row 4 is [aperture,0,0]
deform360.tactile_baseline_rule: latest filename-timestamped baseline at or before the episode recording
deform360.contact_rule: official union over grippers: more than one positive normalized taxel after the released 0.3 normalization threshold

selector.objective: maximum mean contact- and closure-supported end-effector translation from frame 19 through frame 75

next_gate.required_before_fresh_protocol: demonstrate nontrivial object response on source-selected windows using gripper-excluded multiview prefix evidence, then measure persistence on exploratory source outcomes
